topik.nama: 1. Grammar: Passive Voice and Reported Speech

t: be + past participle: The room is cleaned. The letter was written.
Use by + doer only when it matters.
Tense moves back: am → was, will → would, can → could.
Commands: told me to …; questions: asked me where I lived.
must (rule), should (advice), might (possibility), may (permission), could (past ability), needn't (not necessary), mustn't (not allowed).
un-, in-, im-, il-, ir-, dis- make opposites.
make a mistake, do homework, take a photo, pay attention.
a piece of cake = very easy; once in a blue moon = very rarely.
Read the questions first, scan for key words, check details carefully.

nota.t: 16 questions from every chapter: easy to hard. Suggested time: 1 hour.
